plan.title: **Verify Rust 1.85+ toolchain and wasm32 target installed**
plan.body: Check `rustc --version` meets 1.85 minimum per CLAUDE.md; verify `wasm32-unknown-unknown` target is available via rustup. This gates all compilation steps that follow.
plan.acceptance: `rustc --version | grep -oP '1\.\d+' | awk -F. '{exit ($2 >= 85 ? 0 : 1)}'` exits 0. `rustup target list | grep -c "wasm32-unknown-unknown (installed)"` outputs 1.

plan.title: **Compile project in debug mode**
plan.body: Run `cargo build` to catch any compilation errors, missing dependencies, or environment issues. Project declares zero external dependencies, so this should complete cleanly.

plan.title: **Run full test suite: unit + integration**
plan.body: Execute `cargo test --lib` and `cargo test --test integration` to detect pre-existing test failures. Fix any failures found so baseline is clean for future autonomous work.
plan.acceptance: `cargo test --lib 2>&1 | grep -c "test result: ok"` outputs 1. `cargo test --test integration 2>&1 | grep -c "test result: ok"` outputs 1.

plan.title: **Verify pre-commit hook exists and blocks unformatted code**
plan.body: Check that `.git/hooks/pre-commit` exists, is executable, and contains `cargo fmt --check` and `cargo clippy`. Stage an unformatted file and attempt commit; hook must reject it.
plan.acceptance: `ls -la .git/hooks/pre-commit | grep -c "rwx"` outputs 1 (executable). Create `test_unformatted.rs` with bad spacing, stage it, run `git commit -m "test"` → commit rejected with "code is not formatted".

plan.title: **Compile WASM target for counter example**
plan.body: Build the counter example for `wasm32-unknown-unknown` target to verify WASM backend compiles and clock abstraction works. This gate confirms WASM is viable without opening a browser.
plan.acceptance: `cargo build --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -p rui --example counter 2>&1 | tail -1` outputs "Finished `dev` profile".

plan.title: **Run native desktop example and verify rendering**
plan.body: Launch `cargo run -p rui --example counter` to confirm the native backend opens a window, renders the UI, and responds to clicks. Close the window after verifying a click increments the counter.
plan.acceptance: `timeout 3 cargo run -p rui --example counter 2>&1 | grep -c "error"` outputs 0 (no crashes in first 3 seconds).

plan.title: **Verify linting and formatting checks pass**
plan.body: Run `cargo fmt --check` and `cargo clippy` to ensure code meets style and lint standards. Fix any issues found; commits that follow must pass these checks.
plan.acceptance: `cargo fmt --check 2>&1 | tail -1` outputs "(no output)" or "error". `cargo clippy 2>&1 | tail -1` outputs "(no output)".

plan.title: **Validate CLAUDE.md build and test documentation**
plan.body: Audit CLAUDE.md for clarity on build (`cargo build`), test (`cargo test --lib`), and run commands (`cargo run -p rui --example counter`). Ensure examples are executable, not just documented. Add missing sections if any.
plan.acceptance: `grep -c "cargo build" CLAUDE.md` outputs ≥1. `grep -c "cargo test --lib" CLAUDE.md` outputs ≥1. `grep -c "cargo run" CLAUDE.md` outputs ≥1.
